answer: Every claim climbs the meadow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the saffron re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on verifiable delay functions interleaved with localized peer attestation quorums. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
